title: Instrument
description: An instrument: its tunings and the chord keys and suffixes it covers.

id.description: Instrument id; also its directory name under data/.

tunings.description: Fretted only. Each tuning lists the courses from lowest to highest; each course lists the pitches of its strings (one for a single string, several for unison or octave courses).

carriesBass.description: Fretted only. Whether the instrument's lowest note is heard as the bass. False for instruments that comp above a separate bass line (e.g. cavaquinho), where close-position inversions are normal: the validator then doesn't expect the root in the bass. Defaults to true; re-entrant tunings (ukulele) are exempt anyway.

maxFretSpan.description: Fretted only. The largest distance allowed between the lowest and highest fretted notes of a voicing.

keyCount.description: Keyboard only. Number of keys on the instrument.

keys.description: The chord roots covered, in display order.

suffixes.description: The chord suffixes covered, in display order.
